## English

Status bar gains a "kills in the last hour" segment, and the Win32 edge toolbar
becomes rounded, draggable and double-click restorable.

- New status bar segment: **kills in the last hour** (rolling 60-minute count),
  sharing the wording already used on the web panel. It is defined in
  `guicommon.go`, so Win32, Tk and the console all get it, with zh/en i18n.
- Edge toolbar (`toolbar_edge`) is now **docked to the bottom** of the screen by
  default, and sized to the status text instead of spanning the whole work area:
  a short centred pill that no longer covers other windows' close buttons.
- The toolbar has **rounded corners** (clipped with a rounded-rect window region)
  and an explicit left/right text inset, so the text no longer hugs the corner.
- **Drag** the toolbar anywhere on screen and it stays where you put it, even as
  the status text changes; it re-docks (centred, bottom) on the next collapse.
- **Double-click** the toolbar restores the main window. A single click is
  intentionally a no-op, so a stray click cannot pop the window back up.
- Minimizing (`_`) now collapses to the toolbar as well, not just closing (`X`).
- Tk has neither a tray icon nor a window-region API, so `toolbar_edge` is not
  supported there: it logs a Win32-only notice at startup and is otherwise
  ignored, and both READMEs say so instead of silently doing nothing.

Bug fixed along the way:

- The toolbar used to hold a status-bar child window covering its whole client
  area, which swallowed the mouse messages before they reached the toolbar's own
  window procedure. In practice **drag and double-click never fired with a real
  mouse**. The toolbar is now self-painted with no child controls, so every
  click lands on the toolbar itself.

## 中文

状态栏新增「近 1 小时击杀」段；Win32 边缘工具条变圆角、可拖动、双击恢复。

- 状态栏新增：**近 1 小时击杀**（滚动 60 分钟计数），复用网页面板已有措辞。该段定义在 `guicommon.go`，因此 Win32、Tk、控制台三种形态都有，并配了中英文文案。
- 边缘工具条（`toolbar_edge`）默认改为**贴屏幕底边**，且宽度按状态文字计算、不再铺满整个工作区：变成一条居中的短条，不再挡住其他窗口右上角的关闭按钮。
- 工具条加**圆角**（用圆角矩形 window region 裁剪），文字左右改用显式内缩常量，不再紧贴圆角。
- **可拖动**：按住拖到屏幕任意位置即停在那里，状态文字变化也不会把它拽回贴边；下次收起时重新居中贴底。
- **双击**恢复主窗口。单击刻意保持无响应，避免误触把窗口弹出来。
- 点最小化（`_`）现在也会收成工具条，不再只有关闭（`X`）才会。
- Tk 既没有托盘图标也没有窗口 region 接口，因此不支持 `toolbar_edge`：启动时记一条「仅 Win32」日志后忽略该配置，两份 README 也标注了，避免配了却静默无反应。

顺带修复的问题：

- 工具条原本用一个铺满客户区的状态栏**子窗口**显示文字，鼠标消息被子窗口吃掉、到不了工具条自身的窗口过程，导致**真实鼠标下拖动和双击都不生效**。现在工具条改为自绘、不带任何子控件，点击直达工具条本身。
